text_026: Ojobo Agbo Eje is an AI transformation consultant, implementation partner, and trainer. He helps professionals, businesses, institutions, and organizations identify valuable use cases, redesign work, build practical solutions, and develop the capability to use them. His work includes a live public-interest platform and speaking engagements on AI and work.
